name.ja: <ruby>絶<rt>ぜっ</rt></ruby><ruby>超<rt>ちょう</rt></ruby>デモンズダイブ

requirement.en: When your opponent Normal Summons a Level 4 or lower monster, shuffle 2 LIGHT Attribute Fiend Type monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck.

effect.en: Destroy that Normal Summoned monster. Then, you can Special Summon 1 Level 7 or higher LIGHT Attribute Fiend Type monster from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position.
